label: kizuna_health_a_01
text: Hey there! Come on in! Everyone’s welcome in\nthe nurse’s office![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_a_02
text: What brings you here today? I don’t see anything\nsuper wrong with you or your Pokémon...[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_a_03
text: Wait...this is your first time here, isn’t it?[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_a_04a
text: Ohhh, so I guess you transferred in recently.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_a_04b
text: Don’t be silly. I know I haven’t seen you before.\nYou can’t fool me that easily![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_a_06
text: I’ve heard all kinds of rumors. Apparently you fell\noff a cliff right after enrolling in the academy?\r\nAnd even picked a fight with Team Star?[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_a_07
text: Oh yeah! You’ve started your Treasure Hunt\nthing, right?[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_a_08
text: Come tell me about anything super interesting\nyou find out there in your adventures![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_a_09
text: I’m kinda bored just sitting in here all day,\ny’know? I don’t have any classes to teach,\r\nand students only come here to skip class...[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_a_10
text: Sooo yeah, drop by if you can. Deal? Deal![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

label: kizuna_health_a_system_01
text: You became slightly closer with Nurse Miriam!
